cases.name: Ballistic streaming on a uniform field line
cases.description: Run a localized monoenergetic packet through the linked srcSEP/AMPS native registry with every non-streaming operator disabled, then compare its focused-transport characteristic with the independent closed-form solution.

cases.name: Constant-coefficient spatial diffusion Green function
cases.description: Run constant-kappa Parker diffusion in the linked application and compare ensemble moments and finite-bin profiles with the exact Gaussian Green function.

cases.name: Nonuniform diffusion and stochastic-calculus drift
cases.description: Exercise sinusoidal kappa, conservative Ito drift, analytic/numerical coefficient gradients, uniform equilibrium, and a reversed-drift negative control against an independent finite-volume reference.

cases.name: Adiabatic momentum change in expanding solar wind
cases.description: Compare linked Parker momentum updates for constant divergence and spherical constant-speed wind with exact proton/alpha relativistic characteristics.

cases.name: Magnetic focusing in a prescribed field gradient
cases.description: Compare linked zero-scattering focused transport in both field-gradient directions with exact pitch-angle/position characteristics and magnetic-moment conservation.

cases.name: Legendre-mode pitch-angle diffusion
cases.description: Compare production Dmumu evolution for Legendre modes l=1 through 6 with exact modal decay, leakage, normalization, and boundary statistics.

cases.name: Telegraph transport and diffusion limit
cases.description: Compare persistent random flights with telegraph fronts, causal support, exact moments, and the late-time diffusion coefficient.

cases.name: Absorbing-boundary first-passage distribution
cases.description: Compare production Parker drift-diffusion arrivals with the inverse-Gaussian first-passage law across drift and timestep sweeps.

cases.name: Planar diffusive shock acceleration spectrum
cases.description: Compare a controlled linked shock-cycle model with planar DSA spectral indices and acceleration times for compression ratios 2, 3, and 4.

cases.name: Nonuniform turbulence advection
cases.description: Compare both production spectral wave branches on fixed, variable-area, and remapped grids with manufactured characteristic solutions.

cases.name: Time-dependent resonant wave growth and damping
cases.description: Compare one-hot production wave-source histories with exact growth, damping, cancellation, and sinusoidal-rate solutions.

cases.name: Controlled particle-wave total-energy exchange
cases.description: Verify closed particle-wave total-energy accounting with coupled, uncoupled, and deliberately broken-deposition controls.

cases.name: Streaming plus Parker-spiral focusing
cases.description: Verify Parker-spiral geometry, focused streaming, weak scattering, travel time, and field-line storage orientation together.

cases.name: Scattering-focusing equilibrium
cases.description: Verify that coupled focusing and pitch diffusion approach the independent zero-flux stationary distribution.

cases.name: Manufactured spatial-pitch-momentum transport
cases.description: Verify a positive manufactured transport residual and second-order derivative/source assembly across all coordinates.

cases.name: Moving field-line grid conservation and GCL
cases.description: Verify free-stream preservation and conservative remapping on stretched, compressed, and sinusoidally moved segment grids.

cases.name: Moving shock crossing and acceleration
cases.description: Verify moving/stationary shock frame equivalence, continuous crossing times, node coincidence, and DSA slope.

cases.name: Coupled self-generated turbulence feedback
cases.description: Verify the causal streaming-growth-scattering feedback with frozen, one-way, and two-way controls and an energy ledger.

cases.name: Independent focused-transport PDE solver comparison
cases.description: Compare linked production focused transport with an independent conservative finite-volume solver for isolated and combined operators.

cases.name: Publication-informed M-FLAMPA transport reconstruction
cases.description: Run a linked controlled first-passage calculation with the reported 0.05, 0.3, and 1.0 au mean free paths and compare unit-peak profiles with digitized Zhao et al. Figure 7.

cases.name: 2013 April 11 Earth spectra in Liu Figure 12
cases.description: Run event-informed one-field-line Parker transport in the linked srcSEP/AMPS application and compare with ACE, GOES-13, and SOHO Earth observations digitized from Liu et al. Figure 12.

cases.name: 2013 April 11 near-Earth observational release gate
cases.description: Run the linked 2013 April 11 Earth calculation against 80 ACE, GOES-13, and SOHO points from Liu et al. Figure 12 using one amplitude shared by all times, energies, and instruments.

cases.name: 2020 May 29 PSP and STEREO-A radial benchmark
cases.description: Compare linked PSP and STEREO-A time profiles with Cheng et al. Figures 3 and 6 using one amplitude across both spacecraft and all four energy channels.

cases.name: 2013 May 22 interacting-CME diagnostic
cases.description: Compare single- and twin-source linked calculations with GOES-15 and STEREO-A observations from Ding et al. Figure 1 while retaining the one-dimensional model limitation as a non-gating diagnostic.

cases.name: 2014 January 6 connectivity-sensitive diagnostic
cases.description: Compare three fixed connection-delay realizations with the PAMELA fluence spectrum in Bruno et al. Figure 4 using one amplitude across every realization.

cases.name: September 2017 compound-event diagnostic
cases.description: Compare fixed September 4, 6, and 10 source pulses with STEREO-A profiles from Bruno et al. Figure 2 while reporting missing wide-longitude physics explicitly.

cases.name: Calibration ensemble and parameter identifiability pilot
cases.description: Fit one declared calibration law on the six-event training partition, score training and validation members, and quantify bootstrap identifiability without event-by-event retuning.

cases.name: Locked held-out validation campaign pilot
cases.description: Reconstruct the calibration from training observations only and score the two untouched CCMC holdout events without reading holdout targets during fitting.
